title: PubTator 3.0: an AI-powered literature resource for unlocking biomedical knowledge

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《PubTator 3.0: an AI-powered literature resource for unlocking biomedical knowledge》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】PubTator 3.0 (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/pubtator3/) is a biomedical literature resource using state-of-the-art AI techniques to offer semantic and relation searches for key concepts like proteins, genetic variants, diseases and chemicals.
